correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md step 1 classifies disconnected induced triples exactly: same-shore triples or mixed triples containing a deleted pair. Its dual is L_t plus t exceptional missing-matching edges. Starting L_0=sk_1(Delta^{a-1})*sk_1(Delta^{b-1}), sequential deletion of e_j has relative quotient Sigma^2 Q_j, Q_j=K_{a-1,b-1} minus j-1 disjoint edges. Q_j is connected except at (3,3,3); its integral cycle lattice is generated by 4-cycles except final Q_4=C6 for (4,4,4). Oriented joins of two triangle boundaries give integral preimages of each 4-cycle under H3(L_{j-1})->H1(Q_j), hence surjectivity, torsion-free H3 decrement and simple connectivity. Separate free-face collapses/LES give the two exceptional homotopy types. Van Kampen, Hurewicz, Whitehead and combinatorial Alexander duality finish with exact dimensions and no claimed original-complex wedge. Independently reconstructed graph dual faces and mod-two ranks in representative (3,3,1),(3,3,3),(4,4,4),(5,6,3),(6,6,5) cases; these finite checks do not establish integral all-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: A complete natural three-parameter family of ordinary three-cut complexes gains an integral homotopy classification of Alexander duals with a reproducible mechanism for all matching-deletion stages. The two small exceptional phases and integral surjectivity of cycle links are structural, rather than a parameter substitution from the previously proved one-edge and full-crown endpoints.

final_claim: For a,b>=3 and 1<=t<=min(a,b), deleting t vertex-disjoint biclique edges makes the ordinary three-cut Alexander dual a wedge of t circles and B(a,b,t) 3-spheres, except (3,3,3) yields four circles and (4,4,4) yields four circles plus one 2-sphere; the original three-cut complex receives the corresponding free integral homology, not a claimed wedge decomposition.
limitations: A previously unindexed equivalent multiple-chessboard or graph-cut result might cover partial deletions; the multiple-chessboard original full text was not exhaustively inspected.
